boundary_transformation.operation: GDA2020 to WGS 84 (2) + UTM zone 56S (with axis order normalized for visualization)

reference_chips.note: Chips are stored only in analysis/work/reference_chips for review and are not published.

precedence: insufficient_observations: any index has fewer valid observations than the minimum
candidate_artificial: NDVI <= not_vegetation_at_most, MNDWI <= not_water_at_most, NDBI >= artificial_ndbi_at_least and NDBI outside the bare-or-sand range

assess.reference: Visual interpretation of dated Esri World Imagery (Vantor) chips, cross-checked against Queensland Government 2022 aerial imagery; one interpreter, not field-verified.
assess.scored_definition: Assessment-set samples inside the study boundary whose reference label is vegetation, water, artificial or bare_or_sand with high or medium confidence. Mixed, low-confidence and outside-boundary samples are listed but not scored.
